notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached, and the sim backend (gymnasium.make of gym_pusht/PushT-v0, which needs pymunk, shapely, pygame, opencv-python and scikit-image, pyproject.toml:24-30) was never run because gym_pusht is not importable where the gate ran. The fake backend (fake.py) is a pure Python stand-in for gym_pusht.envs:PushTEnv: it models the two-element Box(0, 512) action space and the five-value state observation (pusht.py:161, :184-190), the seeded reset ranges (pusht.py:276-284) and the reset_to_state option (pusht.py:272-285), the PD control loop (pusht.py:164, :247-250), the two-rectangle tee with its centre of gravity (pusht.py:446, :511), the coverage-based reward and the 0.95 termination (pusht.py:232-238, :256-258) and the 300-step TimeLimit that gymnasium.make adds (gym_pusht/__init__.py:6). Its contact solver and inertia are approximations and the fake was never compared with the upstream environment; the fidelity gaps of driver.py say so. PLACEHOLDER NUMBERS: the contact transfer, the torque share, the per-substep damping and the tee moment of inertia in fake.py are test data of the stand-in, marked '# placeholder', and are not in any Fact, Limit or reference. NOT COVERED: the other observation types (environment_state_agent_pos, pixels, pixels_agent_pos), rendering (render(), the human window), the sim backend, and any comparison of the fake with the upstream environment. Five warnings are expected of every Gymnasium family driver (PLAYBOOK.md section 8): G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge records the pending seed and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.values[*], and the seed of cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1); adding units was not attempted because the family derives those schemas. Only catalogue classes are used (cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1), so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the check report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the contact physics of the fake is an approximation named in the fidelity gaps. The reviewer changed no file of the package. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above. GYM-SPACE-REF (claude-opus-5-5, a model, 2026-10-31): driver.py now sets action_space_ref = gym_pusht/envs/pusht.py:161, the upstream code whose bounds the fake's action space copies, so the step bounds derived from the fake's space are upstream_code with that ref; reference.json and REFERENCE.md were regenerated, and the digest above is the re-run gate's.
